errors.text_span: und bei 70 Jahren einen Endwert von etwa 6 % erreicht
errors.evidence: The description states that the black line ("ohne Berufsabschluss") ends at approximately 6% at age 70. However, the chart shows this line ending as the lowest of all four lines, at a value clearly below the 5% mark, approximately at 4%. The description incorrectly places its final value above that of the grey line, which it states ends at 5%.
